title: World Labs Announces Atlas Multimodal World Model
summary: World Labs announces Atlas, a multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer trained on text, images, video, and 3D. Atlas builds a spatial world model that can generate 3D scenes, videos with camera trajectories, depth, and 360° panoramas, differing from Marble by focusing on ongoing world understanding rather than just generating static 3D assets. It supports real-to-sim generation and accepts up to 6 reference images.
